verdict.rationale: Kick documents a genuine double-entry ledger where every transaction generates a journal entry with debit/credit sides, plus a chart of accounts accountants can adjust, supporting the underlying ledger mechanics. However, the evidence describes journal entries as system-generated from transactions/payroll/bills, not explicit manual entry creation by an accountant with supporting memos. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of manually creating/posting a journal entry, memo/description fields on manual entries, and confirmation entries must balance before posting.
